description:
Turns a .lazy file (its JSON text, or a download link from create_graph) into a spec,
        to change it and build it again with create_graph.
        Example: graph_to_spec(graph_file=<the .lazy JSON text>), change the spec, then create_graph.

graph_file.description: The .lazy file: its JSON text, or a download link returned by create_graph.
graph_file.title: Graph File

name: graph_to_spec
title: Turn a graph into a spec
